incidents.name: SATX pair surplus skim
incidents.notes: SATX's transfer logic leaves surplus SATX in the SATX/WBNB pair above its reserves, which the attacker repeatedly harvested with skim() and sync() before withdrawing the pair's WBNB.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xFd80a436dA2F4f4C42a5dBFA397064CfEB7D9508 created 2024-01-24T14:38:05Z by 0x256db6a4f6f8b5310ad7d31bfbf629f9df406c0f, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xbef24b94c205999ea17d2ae4941ce849c9114bfd; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). The PoC header quotes the loss as ~999M SATX; measured from the exploit transaction the attacker nets 49.3396 WBNB, roughly USD 28K at April 2024 prices. 49.34 WBNB x $526.703478/BNB at the incident timestamp 1713283735 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $25,987.
